title: A part retired while on order can still be received and picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 25 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part requested twice on [Line-1] of [WO-1] from [Vendor-1]: [Req-1] already ordered on [PO-1], [Req-2] not yet ordered. [Part-A] is set inactive after that.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Vendors, click "New Vendor", type Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL ONORDER Vendor"), click "Save & Close". [Vendor-1] = that vendor.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL ONORDER PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ONORDER-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00), Vendor [Vendor-1]; leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 0; click Save.
  3. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ONORDER-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL ONORDER PART).
  4. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL ONORDER Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ONORDER-UNIT"); click Create.
  5. [WO-1] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  6. On [WO-1] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL ONORDER line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-1] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-1].
  7. On [Line-1] click ⋮ → "Request part", pick [Part-A], set Source "Vendor", Vendor [Vendor-1], Quantity 1, click "Save Part". [Req-1] = this request. Repeat once more: [Req-2] = the second request.
  8. On [WO-1]'s Parts tab order [Req-1] (its "Order" action). [PO-1] = the purchase order now listed under Parts → Purchase Orders.
  9. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  10. Check the setup worked: [PO-1] holds [Part-A] not yet received; [Req-2] is still a request; [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. On [WO-1]'s Parts tab order [Req-2] (its "Order" action).
  2. Open [PO-1] and click "Receive"; type an invoice number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ONORDER-INV), the delivered quantity 1, Cost $10.00, Sell $20.00; click "Receive".
  3. Back on [WO-1]'s Parts tab, pick the received [Part-A].
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: [Req-2] is ordered (it shows on a purchase order); no inactive-part refusal appears.
  • Step 2: The delivery is received with [Part-A].
  • Step 3: [Part-A] is picked onto [WO-1] (status "Picked").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-E6, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists). Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §5 Modified endpoints.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E6: “A part that becomes inactive while it is on an open purchase order or a special order can still be received, and picked onto the work order that ordered it. Ordering an existing part request is not new work.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §5 Modified endpoints: “Not refused: re-saving the same part (S9-E2), ordering an existing part request (S9-E6), pick, receive, split, invoice”
